entry.title: Stuck at max: why Hyper-V Dynamic Memory won't let go of Linux RAM
entry.summary: Why does a Linux VM's RAM stay at the maximum with Hyper-V Dynamic Memory? The Linux balloon driver reports Committed_AS as demand. A small kretprobe module reports real use instead, and the VM settles near 6.8 GB.
